commerceFigures.catalog: Illustration: a tray of product records. Point at a record, or use the arrow keys, to lift it.
commerceFigures.document: Illustration: a document terminal. Move the pointer through its rows to lift a line.
commerceFigures.workflow: Illustration: a connected path that branches and rejoins. Move the pointer along it to trace the connections.
commerceFigures.checkout: Illustration: a shopping basket. It turns toward the pointer and its handle follows.
commerceFigures.inspection: Illustration: three inspection sieves. Move the pointer vertically to separate a layer.
commerceFigures.drawer: Illustration: three catalog drawers. Move the pointer vertically to open a drawer.
commerceFigures.format: Illustration: a file with uneven rows. Move the pointer down the file to align them.
commerceFigures.relay: Illustration: a branching network. Point at a destination to illuminate the route.
commerceFigures.hub: Illustration: connected tiles around a central hub. Point at a tile to lift it and highlight its connection.
